replication.target_description: Perceived partner ability relative to own ability: PWE versus PEE, 2 partner condition × 2 wave × 2 sex analysis, article p. 9 Inferred meaning of exclusive encouragement. Unique outcome match; supplied p. 10 locator is offset.

n.sample_role: Participants with usable perceived partner ability responses in the two-wave PWE versus PEE analysis; analytic count not explicitly established.
n.exclusions: IC, IWE and PIE outside this model by design. Outcome-specific missingness or exclusions not documented; eligible final condition totals do not establish complete-case N.
n.location: Article p. 9 Inferred meaning of exclusive encouragement; p. 5 Table 1 (PDF pp. 10, 6).

notes: Only n_r assigned. All other fields are unassigned placeholders. Published source title verified. Article page numbers are one less than PDF page numbers. 65 (PWE) + 71 (PEE) = 136 final participants in eligible condition groups; candidate eligible-group total only, not established analytic N. No N inferred from df. The capability model reports F(1,121), p and partial eta squared but no explicit analytic N or outcome-specific exclusions. Its denominator df is not reconciled to the eligible-condition total; that total cannot safely be assigned as complete-case N.
